summary: Independence-engine progress on the Nemotron 3 Nano 30B path: an LLM Bridge-owned Q8_0 dequant-matvec kernel (no GGML/FFI) validated on a real Nano tensor and wired into the forward; exact Nano tokenizer parity with no runtime external process; real Windows physical-RAM detection. Remaining quantized types (Q5_0/Q5_1/Q4_K/Q5_K) still use the pinned GGML kernel, so runtime is NOT yet fully GGML-independent.

commits: 13f9722 feat(kernels): LLM Bridge-owned Q8_0 dequant-matvec kernel (no GGML/FFI)
340ac8b feat(hardware): real Windows physical-RAM and working-set detection
7c353a7 feat(tokenizer): metadata-prefix load + exact Nano tokenizer parity
261154c test(memory): make pressure hysteresis test deterministic on coarse clocks

dependency_audit.method: grep of extern "C" blocks and used FFI symbols across crates/llmbridge-core/src + build.rs

production_ffi_symbols.llmbridge_dequant_matvec_v1: GGML to_float + dot; used by inference::dequant_matvec for Nano Q5_0/Q5_1/Q4_K/Q5_K (Q8_0 no longer routes here)
production_ffi_symbols.llmbridge_dequantize_rows_v1: GGML to_float; used by native_dequant::dequantize_rows for the embedding row and small quantized tensors
production_ffi_symbols.llmbridge_generate_cpu / llmbridge_gener: resident llama.cpp generation for the dense Llama/Qwen CLI backend (not the Nano hybrid path)
production_ffi_symbols.llmbridge_generate_streamed_cpu_v2 / _v3: dense-Llama streamed decoder native matvec (not the Nano hybrid path)

dependency_audit.build_dependency: build.rs builds native static libs via cmake: llmbridge_native, llama, ggml, ggml-cpu, ggml-base (statically linked; NO subprocess, NO llama.cpp server, NO Ollama)

classification.nano_hybrid_orchestration: pure Rust (Mamba-2 conv/SSM, attention+RoPE, MoE routing, sparse experts, full forward)
classification.nano_quant_decode_ggml: Q5_0, Q5_1, Q4_K, Q5_K (still GGML FFI)
classification.process_level_dependency: none (no llama.cpp subprocess/server, no Ollama); GGML is a statically-linked in-process kernel + build dependency

mandatory_A_owned_native_kernel.kernel: native_kernels::q8_0_dequant_matvec (pure Rust, bounded authenticated BoundedLocalReader, no GGML/FFI)
mandatory_A_owned_native_kernel.wired_into: nemotron_nano::matvec routes ggml_type==8 to the owned kernel; used in the real forward for output.weight, blk.*.attn_k, ffn_up_shexp, ffn_down_shexp
mandatory_A_owned_native_kernel.result: PASS — owned kernel matches GGML and an independent FP64 oracle to ~1e-7 on a real Nano tensor

mandatory_B_tokenizer_parity.loader: NemotronTokenizer::from_gguf (self-contained; reads only the GGUF metadata prefix, no external process)
mandatory_B_tokenizer_parity.reference: tests/data/nemotron_tokenizer_reference.txt (official NVIDIA Nemotron ids via HF tokenizers 0.23.3, committed)
mandatory_B_tokenizer_parity.cases_matched: 20/20 exact, including all ASCII/Latin must-match cases (Hi, Hello, 'The capital of France is', 'What is 2 + 2?', digits, whitespace, tabs/newlines)
mandatory_B_tokenizer_parity.note: The committed reference corpus is ASCII/Latin + whitespace/digits/punctuation. Bangla/Russian/Hindi/emoji reference ids are NOT in the committed fixture, so parity for non-Latin scripts is not asserted here (see limitations).

mandatory_C_windows_ram_detection.implementation: hardware::profile()/process_memory() Windows branch via kernel32 GlobalMemoryStatusEx + K32GetProcessMemoryInfo (safe FFI, no new crate, no psapi link)
mandatory_C_windows_ram_detection.process_working_set: now reported (rss + peak working set) via K32GetProcessMemoryInfo
mandatory_C_windows_ram_detection.result: PASS — doctor --json reports valid RAM on the actual Windows host; no fabricated values

low_memory_fix.change: NemotronTokenizer::from_gguf now reads only the metadata prefix (data_offset bytes) instead of std::fs::read of the whole file
low_memory_fix.impact: Nano tokenizer load dropped from ~990 s (reading 22 GB on a 14 GB host, thrashing) to ~0.21 s; restores the never-resident contract for single-file multi-GB models

nano_execution.note: The genuine full 52-block forward (prompt 'Hi' -> token 1319 ' (', 98.67 s, ~2.47 GB/token) was recorded in nemotron_nano_30b_ssd_inference_2026-11-25.json BEFORE Q8_0 routing. The owned Q8_0 kernel is validated numerically equivalent to GGML (~1e-7), so forward outputs are unchanged; the full forward was not re-timed with the owned kernel in this pass.
nano_execution.correctness: genuine-but-UNVALIDATED end-to-end (no runnable nemotron_h_moe reference; RoPE convention assumed) — unchanged from prior evidence

regression.flaky_fix: memory_pressure hysteresis test (1ns interval vs coarse Windows Instant) made deterministic; now passes 5/5 in isolation and in the full suite

remaining_production_dependencies: GGML kernel (llmbridge_dequant_matvec_v1 / llmbridge_dequantize_rows_v1) for Nano Q5_0/Q5_1/Q4_K/Q5_K decode and the embedding row
GGML/llama.cpp native libs for the dense Llama/Qwen resident and streamed backends (separate from the Nano hybrid path)
known_limitations: Runtime is NOT yet GGML-independent: only Q8_0 is owned; Q5_0/Q5_1/Q4_K/Q5_K and the embedding decode still call GGML.
Nano end-to-end logits remain genuine-but-UNVALIDATED (no reference; RoPE assumed).
Tokenizer parity asserted only on the committed ASCII/Latin+whitespace corpus; non-Latin (Bangla/Russian/Hindi/emoji) reference ids are not committed, so not asserted.
No AVX2-optimized owned kernel yet (scalar reference only); no CPU-kernel speed measurement (optional D not done).
No LLM Bridge HTTP API server implemented yet (optional E not done).
Full 52-block forward not re-timed after Q8_0 routing (owned kernel validated numerically equivalent).
